golden_dataset_evals.score_rule: top-k overlap, Spearman/Kendall vs product shortlist; UNKNOWN when no entry
P/R of recognised_institute and seat totals
span accuracy + invariant-6 internship vs employment
hit rate of role-model programme in product shortlist

correlation of product rank with review scores
rank change magnitude; % evidence-driven vs unexplained
predictive hit rate of top-k vs later outcomes

verdict_style_evals.description: Specialised research agent produces audited correct|partially_correct|incorrect|unknown for each test profile; harness scores agreement and coverage
verdict_style_evals.score_rule: agreement rate; top-3 overlap with agent reference; coverage of UNKNOWN; full evidence audit
blockers: circular-data risk if agent only reuses product claims
inter-rater agreement with humans not yet measured

integration_sketch_summary: Extend fmd eval with --eval-kind pipeline|product|verdict and --stream flags. Truth data under data/truth/ with truth_version, as_of, sha256. Fast streams (NIRF-proxy, self-drift) in CI/nightly; slow (verdict-deep, panels) quarterly. Scores always harness-computed; model may only emit structured verdict objects.
build_first: NIRF/NAAC truth tables + proxy ranking metric
5-10 profile verdict-fast canary with human audit
riskiest_assumptions: NIRF/NAAC institution rank is a useful signal for MLT programme choice
Verdict agent can achieve acceptable inter-rater agreement with humans
A realistic acquisition path for true programme-level outcomes exists within 2-3 years
honest_blockers_global: No mature public programme-level employment/registration microdata for Indian B.Sc. MLT
Product evals must lean on proxies + audited verdicts + coverage honesty
